_comment_server_mode: Use 'LOCAL' for same LAN (http://192.168.x.x:8000), 'CLOUD' for internet/GoDaddy (https)
_comment_server_url: IMPORTANT: Replace with your actual GoDaddy domain. Must use HTTPS for CLOUD mode. No trailing slash.
_comment_api_key: Get from: Django Admin → Core → Retailer Masters → Select Retailer → Copy API Key
_comment_retailer_id: Must match Django ERP RetailerMaster.id (numeric primary key, not retailer_code)
_comment_retailer_code: Human-readable code from Django ERP RetailerMaster.retailer_code
_comment_sync_interval: Production: 30-60 seconds. Development: 10 seconds. Lower = more server load.
_comment_timeout: HTTP timeout per API call. Increase for slow connections (15-30 recommended).
_comment_retry: Failed status updates retry this many times before queuing offline.
_comment_log: Relative to retailer_sync folder. Check this file for connection errors.
_comment_cache: SQLite file for local cache + offline queue. Auto-created on first run.
_deployment_steps: STEP 1: Get API key from Django Admin → Core → Retailer Masters
STEP 2: Update server_url with your GoDaddy domain (HTTPS required)
STEP 4: Verify retailer_id matches Django database id field
STEP 6: Expected output: 'Connection successful! Server time: ...'
STEP 8: Monitor logs: tail -f retailer_sync.log (Linux) or type retailer_sync.log (Windows)

_troubleshooting.connection_failed: 1. Check server_url is correct HTTPS URL. 2. Verify SSL certificate. 3. Check api_key matches Django Admin. 4. Ensure retailer status is Active in Django.
_troubleshooting.ssl_error: 1. GoDaddy SSL certificate must be valid. 2. Never use HTTP in CLOUD mode. 3. Check certificate expiry.
_troubleshooting.authentication_failed: 1. Get fresh API key from Django Admin. 2. Ensure no extra spaces in api_key. 3. Check retailer_id is correct numeric value.
_troubleshooting.timeout_error: 1. Increase request_timeout_seconds to 20-30. 2. Check internet connection. 3. Verify GoDaddy server is running.

_security_notes.api_key_security: NEVER share API keys between retailers. Each store must have unique key.
_security_notes.https_required: CLOUD mode enforces HTTPS. Never use HTTP for production.
_security_notes.key_rotation: Rotate API keys every 90 days. Generate new key in Django Admin.
_security_notes.backup_config: Keep secure backup of this file. Required for disaster recovery.
